faults.fault: At 1.5x height the marquee band tiles vertically: 'ARCADE' repeats five times up the front, one of them mirrored/upside-down. The extra height went into repeated marquee bands instead of a longer plain lower body and kick area — this is not a taller cabinet, it is a stacked one, and the doubled text is unreadable garbage.
At 1.8x width the body texture shows vertical streak/smear bands on the front and side (white scratches running full height where the texture was stretched). A player can point at it.

At 1.8x width the control deck stretches instead of gaining a second joystick/button cluster. A wider cabinet is a two-player cabinet; this is one player's deck smeared wider — the sticks and buttons pull apart with blank deck between them.
At 1.8x width the screen stretches to fill the widened cabinet instead of staying one screen in the centre. A wider cabinet does not get a wider tube; the bezel should extend, the screen should not.

wider_means: a wider arcade cabinet is a two-player cabinet -- a second joystick and button set on the control deck, with a wider carcass.
taller_means: a taller arcade cabinet is a full upright cabinet with a longer plain lower body and kick area -- not a bigger screen.
